title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 9: wisdom's house with seven pillars, her invitation to the simple, and the foolish woman's call.

questions.text: How many pillars has wisdom carved out for her house?
questions.explanation: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.

questions.text: What has wisdom prepared for her feast?
questions.explanation: She has prepared her meat, mixed her wine, and also set her table.

answers.text: Her meat and her mixed wine

questions.text: What does wisdom invite the one void of understanding to do?
questions.explanation: She says: "Come, eat some of my bread, drink some of the wine which I have mixed!"

answers.text: Build a house of his own with pillars
Sit with her maidens at the city gates
Bring a gift to set on her table
Eat her bread and drink her mixed wine

questions.text: What contrast does this chapter make between reproving a scoffer and reproving a wise person?
questions.explanation: Don't reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you; reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

answers.text: The scoffer will laugh, but the wise person will weep
The scoffer will hate you, but the wise person will love you
The scoffer will listen, but the wise person needs no reproof
The scoffer will strike you, but the wise person will thank you

questions.text: What happens when you instruct a wise person?
questions.explanation: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser; teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

questions.text: What is the beginning of wisdom, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

answers.text: The knowledge of good and evil

questions.text: How does the saying continue: "If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock..."?
questions.explanation: The verse says: if you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if you mock, you alone will bear it.

answers.text: you will be mocked in return

questions.text: How is the foolish woman described?
questions.explanation: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

answers.text: Crafty, quiet, and full of schemes
Beautiful to look at but bitter within
Rich in possessions but lonely at heart

questions.text: What does the foolish woman say about stolen water?
questions.explanation: She says: "Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant."

questions.text: What does the man who turns in to the foolish woman not know?
questions.explanation: He doesn't know that the departed spirits are there, and that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

answers.text: That her husband is at home
That her guests are in the depths of Sheol
